For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Return only the selected rows.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> slice {flags} (rows)```

## Parameters

 -  `rows`: Range of rows to return.


## Input/output types:

| input     | output    |
| --------- | --------- |
| list&lt;any&gt; | list&lt;any&gt; |
## Examples

Get the last 2 items.
```nu
> [0,1,2,3,4,5] | slice 4..5
╭───┬───╮
│ 0 │ 4 │
│ 1 │ 5 │
╰───┴───╯

```

Get the last 2 items.
```nu
> [0,1,2,3,4,5] | slice (-2)..
╭───┬───╮
│ 0 │ 4 │
│ 1 │ 5 │
╰───┴───╯

```

Get the next to last 2 items.
```nu
> [0,1,2,3,4,5] | slice (-3)..-2
╭───┬───╮
│ 0 │ 3 │
│ 1 │ 4 │
╰───┴───╯

```
